description: The few things Meridian Core needs that normal extensions can't do.

functions.name: getPref
functions.description: Read one of the Firefox settings Meridian's own Settings page shows.

functions.name: setPref
functions.description: Change one of the Firefox settings Meridian's own Settings page shows.

functions.name: openFirefoxSettings
functions.description: Open the full settings page (about:preferences), optionally at a section.

functions.name: openImport
functions.description: Open the import wizard (bookmarks, passwords and history from another browser).
